pātheyya.p: [ patha + ṇeyya. Pathe pathassa vā hitaṃ pātheyyaṃ, ṇeyyo. Sūci. Pathe hitaṃ pātheyyaṃ, eyyo. Dhāna, ṭī. 380. ] (ti) Google Translate On the road, the journey is blessed with blessings. Food.

P: Pātheyya，（nt．） [grd．form．fr．patha] “what is necessary for the road，” provisions for a journey，viaticum Vin．I，244； S．I，44； Dh．235，237； J．V，46，241； DA．I，288； DhA．I，180； III，335； PvA．5，154．（Page 452）
R:
pātheyya：ပါထေယျ （န） （ပထ+ဏျ）
ရိက္ခာ။ ရိက္ခာထုပ်။ လမ်းစာရိက္ခာ။ ခရီးလမ်းစာ။
ပါထေယျံ သဇေ္ဇတွာ၊ ရိက္ခာကို စီရင်၍။
DOP: pātheyya n. [ S. pātheya], provisions for a journey; Abh 380 (~aṃ tu ca sambalaṃ); Vin I 244, 37 (anujānāmi bhikkhave ~aṃ pariyesituṃ); IV 79, 38 (yathāpaṭiyattaṃ ~aṃ parikkhayaṃ agamāsi); S I 44, 9* foll. (kiṃsu bandhati ~aṃ … saddhā bandhati ~aṃ); Dhp 235 (uyyogamukhe ca tiṭṭhasi ~aṃ pi ca te na vijjati; Dhp-a III 335, 26 : ~an ti gamikassa taṇḍulādipātheyyaṃ viya paralokaṃ gacchantassa tava kusalapātheyyaṃ pi natthī ti attho); Th 616 (sīlam ~am uttamaṃ); Ja V 46, 3 (sabbaṃ upakaraṇaṃ ca baddhasattu-ādikaṃ ~aṃ ca cammabhastāyaṃ pakkhipi); VI 524, 17* (~aṃ me karohi tvaṃ); Spk II 104, 17 (dve kira jāyampatikā puttaṃ gahetvā parittena ~ena yojanasatikaṃ kantāramaggaṃ paṭipajjiṃsu); Pv-a 5, 11 (idaṃ pana paralokaṃ gacchantassa ~aṃ bhavissatī ti cintetvā modake pāniyaṃ ca therassa dāpesi); — apātheyya , mfn. ?, without provisions; Vin I 244, 28 (santi bhante maggā kantārā appodakā appabhakkhā na sukarā ~ena gantuṃ); — see also sabbapātheyyaka ( sv sabba ).
